purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.text: This image editor is designed for editing of images intended for use in academic, professional, or technical documents. It provides a range of tools and modifications useful especially for these purposes.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.text: You can use keyboard shortcuts to quickly access various tools and features in the editor. Below is a list of available shortcuts.

tutorial.title: Interactive Tutorial
tutorial.text: A step-by-step walkthrough that introduces the most important features of the editor. Click the button below to start the tutorial and learn how to use the editor effectively.
tutorial.tutorialCompletedTip: The tutorial has been successfully completed.

tutorialSuccessfullyCompleted.title: Tutorial Successfully Completed
tutorialSuccessfullyCompleted.message: Congratulations! You have successfully completed the tutorial. You should now have a good understanding of the main features of the editor and how to use them.

technicalLimitations.title: Technical Limitations
limitations: Only the first page of a PDF file is loaded and displayed.
Very large image files may result in slower performance depending on your device capabilities.
Animated images (e.g., GIFs) are not supported.
Browser refresh will erase unsaved progress.
